description:
Get metadata for all supported DNS providers, including required credential fields and documentation links.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.
name: get_dns_providers

outputSchema.description: The DNS providers credentials can be saved for

count.description: How many providers are supported. A supported provider with no metadata on record is counted here but not listed in `providers`.

providers.description: Each supported provider with metadata on record, keyed by provider id
